spans.s:
m. (-लः)
Blue barleria, (B. caerulea.)
E.
आर्त्त exhausted, and गल to drop, the आ is made short, also आर्तगल.

m. (-लः)
A plant, blue Barleria, (Barleria coerulea.)
E.
आर्त्त pained, गल to eat, अच् aff.

n. (-नं)
Censure, reproach, abuse.
E.
ऋति to blame, a sautra root, and ल्युट् aff.

The end of a bow.
E.
अर्द to hurt, and क्तिन् aff.

The end of a bow.
E.
आङ् before ऋत to move, क्तिन् affix; also अर्त्ति.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Diseased, pained.
m. (-कः)
A kind of cake.
E.
अर्त्ति pain, and कन् added.

f. (-का)
An elder sister, (in theatrical language.) See अत्तिका.

mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं)
1 Pained, afflicted.
2 Disturbed, confounded.
E.
ऋत to hate, to move, participial affix क्त.

m. (-दः)
A cry of pain.
E.
आर्त्त and नाद sound. So आर्त्तस्वर m. (-रः.)

mfn. (वः-वा or -वी-वं)
1 Menstrual, relating to or produced by this discharge.
2 Seasonable, produced in season.
n. (-वं)
1 The menstrual discharge.
2 A flower.
f. (-वी)
A mare.
E.
ऋतु the menses, or a season, अण् aff.

n. (-ज्यं)
The office of a sacrificing priest.
E.
ऋत्विज् a priest, and यञ् aff.

n. (-णं)
Consoling or relieving distress, pain, &c.
E.
आर्त्ति and अपहरण taking away.
